authority.lock_procedure: SV1 2026-11-19 section 4 and 2026-11-20 item 3(6): v3 changes what 'strongest attack' means and specifies rho2, so it is sent to SV1 for review BEFORE any lock and before any rho2 run. After SV1's review, the reviewed version is locked by a lock and run authorization file that the user provides; this file is never edited after review

supersedes_draft.status: Revision 2 of v3, never reviewed or locked; kept unedited as the record of the draft. Revision 1 (ml/configs/mitdb_m1_attack_protocol_v3.json, 67342cbd8aa06ab66a3109d9b4bcc9bceb7df659434deb2e10d26ffc48a0d2dd, commit 699ee1e) is also kept unedited
supersedes_draft.why: The ASI direction version 3 of 2026-11-20 (section 2, route R) adds to route R the condition Pi >= 0.5 when the receiver votes over k beats of one session (k fixed before the run, k = 10 proposed) for both noisy configurations at every noise level found, asks for the ECG reconstruction at the same noise levels, and makes 'S0 reduced to 46 samples + Rice' the standard S0 of every sending baseline. It also answers revision 2's questions 1 and 2 and sets the leakage budget Y to a fraction of beats processed locally

written_after_trial.statement: Revision 1 was written on 2026-11-19, revision 2 on 2026-11-20 and this revision on 2026-11-21, after SV3 and SV1 had seen every number of the v2 week 11 trial (all 9 pairs: Pi, CI95, seed ranges, bacc, session bacc and A1 metrics), SV1's replies of 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-20, the ASI direction version 3 and the S0 compression test of 2026-11-20 (macro-F1 per compressed payload on DS1 validation). No result of any part of v3 exists
written_after_trial.trial_record: The v2 trial (lock 205ec6db, receipt b2861c71, commit d219d36) stays the record: its 9 pairs are never rerun or edited, and its numbers are never overwritten. v3 reads the saved v2 attackers and predictions only (parts b and d)
written_after_trial.what_the_trial_motivated: Parts a and b come from SV3's review of 2026-11-14 items 2 and 4 and SV1's reply of 2026-11-19 sections 2 and 4; part c from SV1 2026-11-19 section 3, 2026-11-20 item 3(6) and the ASI direction version 3 section 2; part d from SV1 2026-11-20 item 3(3); the S0c pairs from the ASI direction version 3 (changes table, row 'Doi chung gui S0'). Pi_min, the Pi formula, the attack models, the data split and the capacity decision are not changed after the trial

predecessor.inheritance: Every v2 section not changed below applies unchanged: threat_model (with the additions in limitations), attacks A1/B_naive/B_adaptive definitions, observed_tensor, privacy_metric (Pi, bacc, seeds, bootstrap, session_variant, reconstruction_metrics), data.trial_week11 (identities, labels, time split, attacker validation, counts), checkpoints, attack_models, training, capacity_check result

changes_from_v2.what: Part a: B_naive and A1 at s9 and at s10 (the logits tensor), rho0 only, DS1 trial data and rules, base architecture (capacity decision of the v2 trial carried over, no new capacity check). Pi at s10 is reported as Pi_logits, never as Pi(s10) of the action set

Part b: new B variant B_composite for rho0: from the tensor observed at s, the edge computes the observed tensor of a deeper split s' (frozen ops, registry v2 quantization) and applies the trained B_naive attacker of (s', rho0). No training. Pi_v3(s, rho0) = 1 - max over variants (B_naive at s and B_composite s -> s' for every available s' > s), the v2 rule 'max over variants' with one more variant
changes_from_v2.source: SV1 2026-11-19 sections 2 and 4(b); SV3 2026-11-14 items 2 and 4(b)

changes_from_v2.what: Part c: rho2 (per-channel Gaussian noise on z_s2, checkpoint A frozen) and the control 'S0 + noise'. Both are compared at equal validation macro-F1 (four matched targets); each configuration passes only if the per-beat Pi and the k-beat Pi (k = 10) both reach Pi_min; the action-set rules are declared before the run. DS1 only; within the route R effort cap
changes_from_v2.source: SV1 2026-11-19 sections 3 and 4(c); SV1 2026-11-20 item 3(6); ASI direction v3 section 2 (route R)

changes_from_v2.what: Part d: re-identification versus the number k of beats the edge sees per patient, from saved predictions only. Discussion metric under rho0; under part c the same computation at k = 10 is a pass condition
changes_from_v2.source: SV1 2026-11-20 item 3(3); ASI direction v3 section 2

changes_from_v2.what: Pi(s10) of the action set is 1 by construction (nothing is sent to the edge at s10); the s10 measurement of part a is an upper bound for every s < 10 under rho0, not a filter on s10

Limitations add the same-session closed-set setting, the direction of each bound (attacker strength vs session confound), the leakage budget Y as a local fraction that does not hide identity, and the vote aggregators that were not tested
changes_from_v2.source: SV1 2026-11-19 section 7; SV1 2026-11-20 item 3(3); ASI direction v3 sections 3 and changes table

changes_from_v2.what: Implementation detail: B_composite computation, the reproduction gate on the loaded v2 attackers, the noise generator, the matched-utility search, the pre-drawn noise realizations of the adaptive attackers and the k-beat vote rules, fixed here before any run
changes_from_v2.source: Needed to make items 2-4 and 8 exact; listed for SV1 to see

changes_from_v2.what: S0c, the standard compressed S0 (46 samples + Rice): B_naive and A1 at S0c under rho0 (part a), S0c as a source of B_composite (part b) and as a part d row; the S0 control of part c is applied to S0c. Conditional on the S0c definition being bound by SHA-256 before the lock; otherwise the S0c pairs are not run and part c uses the full-length control
changes_from_v2.source: ASI direction v3, changes table row 'Doi chung gui S0' and section 1

changes_from_revision_2: Part c pass rule: Pi per beat >= 0.5 AND Pi_k10 >= 0.5 (k = 10, fixed here) AND macro-F1 >= the gate, for both configurations at every alpha_t (ASI direction v3 section 2). Pi_k10 is 1 - max over variants, vote rules (hard and soft) and sampling modes (consecutive and scattered)
Part c saves per-beat log-probabilities of every attacker so that the soft vote needs no training

Part c reconstruction: A1 trained adaptively on noisy tensors at the source split for both configurations at every alpha_t, plus the training-free floor (identity or the edge's own interpolation); reported, not a pass condition

Part c control moved to S0c (noise on the 46 reduced samples, then the S0c encoding) when the S0c definition is bound; the Rice payload size per beat at each alpha_t is reported. Fallback: the revision 2 control on the full 360-sample beat
New S0c pairs in parts a, b and d (rho0)
Decision table aligned with the ASI direction v3 section 2: an R2 pass puts s2 + rho2 in the candidate set (energy and latency then measured against S0/S10 alternation at the same requirement)
Effort: route R within 1.5 person-weeks (ASI direction v3 section 2); DS1 run in week 12, Pi-F1 curves and controls delivered in week 13 (ASI direction v3 section 4)
Limitations: leakage budget Y is the fraction of beats processed locally (ASI direction v3 section 3); the Pi-weight question of revision 2 is answered and removed

questions_for_SV1: revision 2 questions 1 (frozen checkpoint) and 2 (four targets) answered by ASI direction v3 section 2 and removed; questions 3-5 kept; new questions on k, the vote rules, the S0c definition and the control placement

source_bindings.v2_bindings: Every source_bindings entry of v2 applies unchanged (decisions 03/11, reviews 05/11, 09/11, 13/11, NoPeek protocol v2, grid selection, checkpoint lock A, NoPeek checkpoint Release, quantization, package A)

asi_direction_v3.sections: changes table (rows 'Ngan sach du lieu Y', 'Doi chung gui S0', 'Duong R'), 1 (S0 compression test), 2 (route R: frozen checkpoint A, four macro-F1 targets, k-beat vote, reconstruction at the same noise levels, decision table, effort cap), 3 (Y, reported privacy metrics), 4 (week plan)
asi_direction_v3.note: Supersedes the ASI direction version 2 where they differ

asi_direction_v2.note: Kept for the parts that version 3 leaves unchanged

attack_v2_trial_receipt.use: Binds by SHA-256 the saved v2 attackers (<pair>-attackers.pt) and test predictions (<pair>-arrays.npz) under ml/data/runs/attack-m1-v2-trial-20261113/ that parts b and d read; every file is checked against outputs_sha256 before it is loaded. These arrays hold argmax predictions only (no probabilities), so the soft vote is not available for the v2 pairs

nopeek_protocol_v2_utility.use: Part c reuses its utility metric (validation macro-F1 fixed4), A's validation confusion and the gate (19/20 of A, exact Fraction)

s0c_definition.needed: The exact S0c encoding used by the 2026-11-20 compression test and by the planned contract I1 payload type (ASI direction v3): input representation (normalized or ADC units), the reduction of 360 samples to 46 (method and positions), the integer representation of the 46 values, the Rice parameters and header, and the edge-side decoding and interpolation back to 360 samples, as a file or script from SV1/SV2 with its SHA-256
s0c_definition.rule: Bound before the lock or not at all: without it, every S0c item of this version is marked NOT_RUN and part c uses the full-length control C0. The compression-test macro-F1 (0.5681 on DS1 validation) is not re-measured or used by any attack decision

s0c_observed_tensor.definition: What the edge holds after Rice decoding: the 46 reduced values of each beat, exactly as the bound s0c_definition produces them (Rice is lossless, so the payload and the decoded values carry the same information). Attacker input: the 46 values as an NCL tensor [1, 46] in FP32, after the dequantization the definition specifies
s0c_observed_tensor.edge_interpolation: x_c = the edge's interpolation of the 46 values back to 360 samples, exactly as the bound definition; x_c is the input of the frozen model at the edge and the start of every composite from S0c
s0c_observed_tensor.golden_check: For the 20 package A golden beats, SV3's implementation of the encoding and of the interpolation must reproduce the reference outputs that come with the bound definition bit for bit (or within the tolerance the definition states); any difference stops the S0c items before a number exists

part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.observed_tensor: s9 and s10 as v2 observed_tensor: z_s of checkpoint A computed one beat at a time, to_ncl with L = 1, registry v2 quantize_per_channel then dequantize_per_channel; the attacker input is the dequantized FP32 [C] vector (C = 32 at s9, 5 at s10). s0c: s0c_observed_tensor
part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.logits_definition: The s10 tensor is the FP32 PyTorch output of the full checkpoint A on the normalized beat (classifier.4, 5 values N, S, V, F, Q), quantized like every other split: the nominal 15 B tensor (5 INT8 + 5 FP16) of table_iii. It stands for every logits vector the edge can compute from z_s with the FP32 reference tail it knows (threat_model.knows: tail weights)
part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.kv260_logits: Not attacked: the KV260 INT8 logits (multiples of 0.125) are another function of z_s; omitting a variant can only leave Pi higher, so every Pi here stays an upper bound. Listed in limitations
part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.golden_check: rho0 z_s9 and z_s10 of the 20 package A golden beats must equal golden/z_s9.npy and golden/z_s10.npy bit for bit (v2 golden_check extended to s9, s10); s0c: s0c_observed_tensor.golden_check

attacks.B_naive: s9, s10: v2 attack_models.B_classifier.base.NC (MLP 128); s0c: v2 base.NCL (2 blocks, 64 channels, kernel 5) on [1, 46]. 3 seeds 20261030, 20261031, 20261101. Per-beat log-probabilities on the test part are saved with the argmax predictions
attacks.A1: s9, s10: v2 attack_models.A1_decoder, seed 20261030. s0c: the training-free floor x_c (edge interpolation) and a trained refiner Conv1d(1, 16, 5) + ReLU, Conv1d(16, 16, 5) + ReLU, Conv1d(16, 1, 5) (padding 2) applied to x_c, MSE against the normalized x, seed 20261030, v2 A1 training settings; both reported, the headline is the one with the lower mean NRMSE on the attacker-validation part. Reported, not part of Pi

part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.architecture: Base: the v2 trial capacity check (s0 mean bacc 0.8256 >= 0.80) decided 'base' for every split; it is not repeated and not revised. s0c uses the same base NCL family
part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.reported: Per pair as v2 (Pi, CI95, seed range, per-seed results, session bacc, A1 metrics); Pi(s9) and Pi(s0c) are then also combined with B_composite in part b
part_a_s9_logits_and_s0c.names: Pi_v3(s9, rho0) and Pi_v3(s0c, rho0) after part b; Pi_logits = Pi of B_naive on the s10 tensor (no deeper split exists, so no composite)

reading_declared_before_run.Pi_logits_below_Pi_min: Pi_logits < 0.5: with this metric no offload configuration that keeps the logits computable at the edge (every s < 10 under rho0, and S0c) can reach Pi_min. Recorded as a property of the problem; Pi_min is NOT lowered
reading_declared_before_run.Pi_logits_at_least_Pi_min: Pi_logits >= 0.5: no such statement; Pi(s < 10) stays what its own measurements give
reading_declared_before_run.Pi_s9_at_least_Pi_min: Pi_v3(s9, rho0) >= 0.5: report to SV1, who reopens the bottleneck question (SV1 2026-11-19 section 3, last part)
reading_declared_before_run.Pi_s9_below_Pi_min: Pi_v3(s9, rho0) < 0.5: the bottleneck route stays closed
reading_declared_before_run.Pi_s0c: Pi_v3(s0c, rho0) is the privacy entry of the standard S0 in every table; the trial Pi(s0) of the full beat stays a trial number and is not substituted for it
reading_declared_before_run.action_set: Pi(s10) of the action set is 1 by construction (SV1 2026-11-19 section 5); Pi_logits never filters s10

part_b_B_composite.applies_to: rho0 (checkpoint A) only: every split shares one model, so the edge that receives z_s holds every op after s. Under rho1 each split is a different checkpoint whose deeper-split attackers do not exist; B_composite is not defined for rho1 in this version and Pi(s, rho1) stays B_naive
part_b_B_composite.argument: The edge that receives the observed tensor u_s at s can compute u_s' for any s' > s and run the attacker trained at s'. So the true Pi(s, rho0) cannot exceed Pi(s', rho0) except through the quantization (or, for S0c, the reduction) error at s; the measured order 0.100 -> 0.068 reflects attacker weakness at shallow splits. This is the hypothesis part b measures; the trial value Pi(s0) = 0.183 is not used anywhere

sources_and_targets.pairs: Every (s, s') with s in source_splits, s' in target_splits, s' deeper than s (s0 and s0c are shallower than every target): 27 composite evaluations (6 + 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1); the 6 from s0c only if s0c_definition is bound
sources_and_targets.attackers: s' in {2, 4, 5, 8}: the v2 trial attackers <s'>-rho0-attackers.pt (s0 is never a target); s' in {9, 10}: the part a attackers

computation.input: u_s = the observed tensor at s exactly as v2 observed_tensor (for s0: dequantized INT8 x, the 362 B payload); for s0c: x_c, the edge interpolation of the 46 values (s0c_observed_tensor)
computation.ops: frozen ops OPS[CUTS[s]:CUTS[s']] of checkpoint A (week3_sv2_common.CUTS), with CUTS[s0c] = CUTS[s0]; CPU, week3_sv2_common.configure; batched when s' <= 8, one beat at a time when s' >= 9; s9 sources enter as [N, 32] (to_ncl undone)
computation.quantization: z'_s' -> to_ncl -> quantize_per_channel -> dequantize_per_channel (registry v2), so the attacker sees the same kind of tensor it was trained on; the edge can do this itself
computation.standardization: Mean and std of the attacker-train part of the genuine u_s' (the statistics the s' attacker was trained with), recomputed with v2 attack_models.input_standardization
computation.prediction: Each of the 3 seeds' B attackers of (s', rho0) in eval mode on the standardized composite test tensors; argmax and per-beat log-probabilities saved; same device and precision settings as the v2 trial (CUDA RTX 5060, deterministic, TF32 off)
computation.metric: Per seed bacc and Adv on the test part; Adv_composite(s -> s') = mean over the 3 seeds
computation.outputs: Composite test predictions and log-probabilities per seed and per (s, s') are saved with the test rows and labels (input of part d)

part_b_B_composite.reproduction_gate: Before any composite number: for every loaded target attacker, its predictions on the genuine u_s' test tensors must equal the saved pred_seed<seed> arrays of the v2 trial npz (s' in {2, 4, 5, 8}) or of part a (s' in {9, 10}) element for element. Any difference stops the run before a composite number exists; the difference is reported to SV1
part_b_B_composite.Pi_v3: Pi_v3(s, rho0) = 1 - max(Adv_naive(s), max over s' of Adv_composite(s -> s')), with Adv_naive(s) read from the v2 trial (s in {0, 2, 4, 5, 8}) or part a (s9, s0c). The CI95 is the v2 bootstrap applied to the predictions of the winning variant. Every variant's Adv, Pi, seed range and session bacc are reported
part_b_B_composite.unmeasured_splits: s1, s3, s6, s7 are not evaluated; no Pi is stated for them

reading_declared_before_run.role: Part b does not decide a branch: the no_signal branch is already taken (SV1 2026-11-19 section 3). It replaces the trial ordering with the upper bound the paper may state and tests the composite argument
reading_declared_before_run.argument_holds: Pi_v3(s, rho0) close to min over s' >= s of Pi_naive(s', rho0) at every source: the paper writes that splitting under rho0 does not hide the patient at any measured s, with Pi as an upper bound
reading_declared_before_run.argument_fails: If quantization or reduction at s makes a composite clearly weaker than B_naive at s' (Adv_composite well below Adv_naive(s')), report the numbers as they are; Pi_v3 still takes the max over variants and stays an upper bound

k_beat_vote.use: Part d (rho0, discussion) and the part c pass condition (k = 10)

modes.consecutive: Per patient, the test beats in time order cut into non-overlapping blocks of k consecutive beats; a last block shorter than k is dropped
modes.scattered: Per patient, 200 draws of k test beats without replacement, numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([20261120, 4, pair_key, k])) with pair_key the index of the evaluated (configuration, split, alpha_t) in the run manifest written before the first draw, as when a policy offloads only part of the beats

vote_rules.hard: Majority of the per-beat argmax predictions in a block or draw (ties: lowest label)
vote_rules.soft: Argmax of the sum of the per-beat log-probabilities in a block or draw. Needs saved log-probabilities: available for every new attacker of v3, not for the v2 trial pairs (receipt b2861c71 stores argmax only)

k_beat_vote.statistic: Per seed: bacc_k = mean over the N patients of the fraction of the patient's blocks or draws assigned to the right identity; Adv_k = clip((bacc_k - 1/N) / (1 - 1/N), 0, 1); mean over the 3 seeds; seed range reported
k_beat_vote.Pi_k: Pi_k = 1 - max over the variants available for the evaluated configuration, the vote rules available and the two modes, of the mean-seed Adv_k; every (variant, rule, mode) value is reported
k_beat_vote.CI95: Consecutive mode: within-patient bootstrap over the k-beat blocks, 2000 resamples, identity set fixed, on the winning (variant, rule); scattered mode: the 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles over the 200 draws are reported instead of a bootstrap
k_beat_vote.difference_from_session_bacc: The consecutive k = 10 value can differ from the v2 session bacc, which kept the shorter last block

part_c_rho2_and_s0_noise_control.status: Specification for SV1's review; runs only after the lock of the reviewed version; DS1 in week 12, Pi-F1 curves and the control delivered in week 13, within the 1.5 person-weeks of route R (ASI direction v3 sections 2 and 4)

configurations.R2[alpha]: s2 + rho2: on the device, z_s2 of checkpoint A plus Gaussian noise e[c, l] ~ N(0, (alpha * sigma_c)^2), independent per beat, channel and position, then registry v2 quantization; the edge dequantizes and runs the frozen tail
configurations.C0c[alpha]: Standard control when s0c_definition is bound: the 46 reduced values v of each beat plus Gaussian noise N(0, (alpha * sigma_v)^2) per value, independent per beat, then the rest of the S0c encoding (integer representation and Rice); the edge decodes, interpolates to 360 samples and runs the whole frozen model
configurations.C0[alpha]: Fallback control, used only when s0c_definition is not bound before the lock: the normalized beat x plus Gaussian noise N(0, (alpha * sigma_x)^2) per sample, then registry v2 quantization, sent at s0 (revision 2 definition)
configurations.sigma: sigma_c = population std over N and L of channel c of the clean z_s2 of checkpoint A on DS1 train; sigma_v = population std over N and the 46 positions of the clean reduced values on DS1 train; sigma_x = population std of the normalized x over DS1 train. Computed once and written to a file with its SHA-256 before any noisy evaluation. alpha only parametrizes each configuration; the configurations are compared at equal macro-F1, never at equal alpha (SV1 2026-11-20 item 3(6))
configurations.noise_placement_reason: Noise on the 46 reduced values rather than on x before the reduction: a reduction that averages or drops samples also removes part of the noise, so noise added before it would buy less privacy per unit of macro-F1 and would make the control look weaker than it can be. Questions_for_SV1 item 3

part_c_rho2_and_s0_noise_control.model: Checkpoint A frozen: no retraining of head or tail (ASI direction v3 section 2)
part_c_rho2_and_s0_noise_control.noise_generator: numpy.random.default_rng(numpy.random.SeedSequence([20261120, config_index, alpha_key, part_index, draw])) with config_index 0 = R2, 1 = C0 (fallback), 2 = C0c; alpha_key = round(alpha * 1e6); part_index 0 attacker-train, 1 attacker-validation, 2 test, 3 DS1 validation; draws 0, 1, 2 for utility; draw 0 for attacker-validation and test; draws 0-4 for the attacker-train realizations of the adaptive attackers and of A1

utility.data: DS1 validation (as NoPeek v2 utility; the 4 validation records of the DS1/DS2 split); DS2 never used
utility.metric: Macro-F1 over N, S, V, F (fixed4), argmax over 5 outputs, zero_division 0, from the confusion summed over the 3 noise draws, exact with Fraction; per-draw macro-F1 and accuracy also reported
utility.gate: Passes when macro-F1 >= 19/20 x F1_A = 218290747091/404383914000 (0.5398), the threshold of route R and of rho1
utility.payload_size: C0c only: Rice payload bytes per beat (mean, median, maximum) on DS1 validation at every alpha evaluated, with the bound encoder; header bytes as the definition states. Noise raises the entropy of the reduced values, so the payload grows with alpha; this is reported for the cost comparison in G5 and decides nothing here

matched_utility_search.targets: t in {0.99, 0.98, 0.97, 0.95} x F1_A; the last target is the gate (ASI direction v3 section 2: 99, 98, 97 and 95 % of the original macro-F1)
matched_utility_search.rule: For each configuration and target t, utility only on the coarse grid; then bisection in log(alpha) between the largest grid alpha with macro-F1 >= t and the next grid alpha, 8 steps; alpha_t = the largest alpha found with macro-F1 >= t. If even 0.05 fails t, alpha_t is searched downward to 0.05/2^8; if no alpha reaches t, the target is reported unreachable. If macro-F1 is not monotone on the grid, the first crossing from small alpha is used and the non-monotone points are reported
matched_utility_search.selection_data: DS1 validation only; selecting alpha on DS1 validation is allowed (DS2 stays closed and unused)
matched_utility_search.privacy_points: Pi and Pi_k10 are evaluated at alpha_t of each reachable target for each configuration: at most 8 privacy points (4 targets x 2 configurations), at least 4 levels per configuration

privacy.data: v2 trial data and time split (DS1, N = 22)
privacy.attacker_knowledge: The attacker knows the mechanism, the checkpoint and alpha and sigma (SV1 2026-11-20 item 3(6); roadmap 8.3), and holds labelled clean attacker-side beats of the N patients as in v2

variants.B_naive: Base architecture at the source (s2 for R2: NCL on [16, 180]; s0c for C0c: NCL on [1, 46]; s0 for C0: NCL on [1, 360]), trained on one noisy realization (draw 0) of the attacker-train tensors
variants.B_adaptive: Same architecture, trained on the attacker-train beats with the noise regenerated from the known distribution: epoch e uses realization (e - 1) mod 5 of 5 pre-drawn realizations (draws 0-4)
variants.B_composite_adaptive: For each s' in {2, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10} deeper than the source: the edge computes u_s' from the noisy observed tensor (part b computation, frozen checkpoint A; for C0c from the interpolated x_c); a base-architecture attacker at s' is trained on the same pipeline applied to the 5 attacker-train realizations (epoch e uses realization (e - 1) mod 5) and tested on the composite of the noisy test tensors. Standardization statistics from realization 0 of its own attacker-train part

privacy.seeds_and_training: Every variant: 3 seeds 20261030, 20261031, 20261101, v2 training settings (AdamW, early stop on attacker-validation bacc with the fixed draw-0 validation tensors, patience 5, max 50 epochs, TF32 off). Per-beat test log-probabilities are saved with the argmax predictions
privacy.Pi: Pi(config, alpha) = 1 - max over the variants of the mean-seed Adv (v2 privacy_metric); CI95 by the v2 bootstrap on the winning variant; every variant reported
privacy.Pi_k10: k_beat_vote.Pi_k at k = 10 over the same variants, both vote rules and both modes, from the saved test predictions and log-probabilities; no further training. The other k values are reported as curves
privacy.variant_count: Per privacy point: 2 + 5 = 7 variants for R2, 2 + 6 = 8 for C0c (or C0), each with 3 seeds

reconstruction.why: The leakage budget Y protects ECG content, so the reconstruction at each noise level is reported with Pi (ASI direction v3 section 2)
reconstruction.floor: Training-free: R2 none (no identity map from z_s2); C0c: the edge interpolation x_c of the noisy reduced values; C0: the dequantized noisy x (v2 A1 s0 identity)
reconstruction.A1_adaptive: Trained at the source on the 5 attacker-train realizations (epoch e uses realization (e - 1) mod 5), MSE against the clean normalized x, seed 20261030, v2 A1 training settings. R2: v2 A1_decoder s2 mirror; C0c: the part a s0c refiner on x_c; C0: the same refiner on the noisy x
reconstruction.metrics: v2 reconstruction_metrics (NRMSE, Pearson, R-peak error) on the draw-0 noisy test tensors, for the floor and for A1_adaptive; the headline is the better of the two by attacker-validation NRMSE

action_set_rules_declared_before_run.pass: A configuration passes at alpha when Pi(config, alpha) >= 0.5 and Pi_k10(config, alpha) >= 0.5 (point estimates, strongest variant, vote rule and mode) and macro-F1 >= the gate
action_set_rules_declared_before_run.control_passes: If C0c (or C0) passes at some alpha: S0 + noise is preferred to s2 + rho2 (revision 2 rule, ASI direction v3 section 2), whatever R2 gives; both privacy-utility curves are reported; report to SV1 at once
action_set_rules_declared_before_run.only_R2_passes: If no control alpha passes and R2 passes at some alpha: s2 + rho2 enters the candidate set; SV1 then measures its energy and latency and compares it with the S0/S10 alternation policy at the same requirement (ASI direction v3 section 2); report to SV1 at once
action_set_rules_declared_before_run.neither: Otherwise: negative result for the mechanism and the range tried, with the per-beat Pi, Pi_k10 and the matched-F1 curves of both configurations; the leakage indicator stays in the system evaluation
action_set_rules_declared_before_run.comparison: At every reachable target t: Pi, Pi_k10 and the reconstruction metrics of R2 and of the control at alpha_t, with CI95 and per-variant values, side by side at equal macro-F1
action_set_rules_declared_before_run.decision_time: SV1 decides routes R and K at the end of week 13 (2026-12-06) with these rules (ASI direction v3, decision milestones)

limitations: v2 limitations apply (N = 21 official, no sex/age inference, trial on DS1 patients seen in training)

Closed-set re-identification of N patients with attacker train and test from two halves of the same record: identity is confounded with session features (electrodes, posture), so Adv is higher than for cross-session re-identification; MIT-BIH has one session per patient and cannot separate the two

Direction of the bounds: with respect to attacker strength every measured Pi is an upper bound of the in-session Pi; with respect to the session confound the in-session Adv is an upper bound of the cross-session Adv (the in-session Pi a lower bound of the cross-session Pi). The negative result is therefore stated for the in-session closed-set task
The edge already knows which device sends; the threat is linking beats to an identity in another dataset or session, of which the in-session Adv is an upper bound

Leakage budget Y (ASI direction v3 sections 3 and changes table): Y is the fraction of beats processed fully on the device (>= p); it limits how much ECG content leaves the device and does not hide identity, since a few beats of one session re-identify the patient (part d). Pi per beat, Pi_k and the reconstruction metrics are reported separately and are not weights of Y

Aggregation across beats: Pi_k uses hard and soft votes over per-beat attacker outputs. An edge could also average aligned noisy tensors of several beats before classifying, which removes independent noise faster; this aggregator is not tested, so Pi_k stays an upper bound with respect to stronger aggregation
KV260 INT8 logits are not attacked; B_composite and part a cover rho0 only

rho2 and the S0 control are evaluated with checkpoint A frozen (no noise-aware fine-tune); Pi for them is an upper bound with respect to stronger adaptive attackers (for example denoising networks or more noise realizations)
S0c results hold for the bound S0c encoding only; another reduction or interpolation needs a new measurement
